---
name: vibeschool-adversarial-review
description: Independent-style adversarial review checklist for VibeSchool changes before certification.
---
# Adversarial Review
Review the completed change as if trying to break it. Challenge assumptions, stale data, empty states, duplicate submission, retries, races, cross-tenant access, authorization bypass, partial persistence, provider failure, malformed input, mobile constraints, accessibility, stale main, migration drift and rollback. Search for second sources of truth and weakened controls. Material findings must be repaired and reverified before certification; findings may not be downgraded because implementation is already complete.
